title: SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions
description: Starting November 11, 2026, threat actors exploited unauthorized access to ConnectWise ScreenConnect instances used by managed service providers to deploy a malicious worm called SCKit. This worm installs unauthorized remote-access clients on customer endpoints and targets IT technician workstations by hijacking authenticated ScreenConnect sessions. SCKit establishes persistence on infected devices and uses a component named RelayTrap to deliver malicious payloads to connecting technicians, enabling lateral movement and further compromise. The attack leverages a reported authentication flaw in certain RMM+ extension versions and abuses legitimate ScreenConnect functionality. Removing unauthorized clients alone does not eliminate persistence or session exposure. Mitigation involves investigating technician workstations and downstream endpoints and applying fixes for known vulnerabilities.
